single_no_hand_wipe.mechanism: Single 1-frame MediaPipe landmark detection drop triggers self.frames.clear() in add_frame(), wiping 48-frame deque.

transient_setup_motion.mechanism: Early hand movement during frames 1-48 produces a transient high-confidence wrong prediction before the true gesture matures.
transient_setup_motion.fix_type: Debounce tuning, gesture onset filter, or selecting highest-confidence event

wrong_first_event.mechanism: Model confusion or out-of-distribution dynamic sequence producing >=0.75 confidence for wrong sign.
wrong_first_event.fix_type: Confidence threshold tuning or temporal smoothing

no_event_low_conf.mechanism: Model prediction never maintained stability >=2 with confidence >=0.75 across rolling windows.
no_event_low_conf.fix_type: Model training data augmentation or threshold calibration
